events.title: WPFW 50th Anniversary Gala
events.short_description: An evening honoring five decades of community-powered radio: music, guest speakers, special tributes, and the people who have kept 89.3 on the air since 1977. Tickets on sale in November.
events.full_description:
WPFW turns fifty on February 28, 2027, and this is the night the station marks it. An evening of music, guest speakers and special tributes at Martin's Crosswinds in Greenbelt, Maryland.

Some of the people in that room signed the station on in 1977. Some found 89.3 last week on a car radio. It is the first real chance in a long time to get listeners, volunteers, programmers and staff under one roof.

Tickets go on sale in November. The start time will be announced here and on the air.
